scientific_integrity: The claim is limited to the binomial-thinning self-decomposability boundary. The ordinary additive infinite-divisibility boundary is credited to Letac, Malouche and Maurer (2002); mass-curvature and hazard classifications are outside the claim.
scientific_limitations: Classification requires independent summands, positive real negative-binomial shape and strictly interior Bernoulli and negative-binomial probabilities. Finite rational diagnostics are not proofs. Earlier equivalent formulations remain a residual historical-priority risk.
title: Sharp Bernoulli-thinning boundary for Bernoulli–negative-binomial counts
